thread:
Aisha: quick q — the new mini-savings card on the dashboard is showing a bunch of negative 'cache savings' for some tenants. Anyone else seeing this?
Tom: yeah saw that earlier, looks like negative when prefetch is shared across routes.
Megan: negative savings usually means our amortization is over-crediting another route, then later charging back. not ideal UX.
Aisha: i get the math but product wants something understandable for PMs. they expect 'savings' to be >= 0. :grimacing:
Leo: could be sampling + small denominator. if a tenant has very few hotpath hits but picked up most of the prefetch credit, the per-request delta flips negative after normalization.
Tom: agreed. i dug into the query — our current calc is: 
```
SELECT tenant_id,
  SUM(prefetch_cost_saved) - SUM(prefetch_credit_allocated) AS net_prefetch_savings
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= $start
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
That doesn't clamp or account for shared-prefetch amortization window.
Megan: UX options: show 'raw' value, then a second column 'amortized (>=0)' where we floor to 0 and show a tooltip explaining negative drift due to cross-route reconciliation.
Aisha: product prefers a single number though. they asked for a heuristic that hides noise for small sample sizes.
Leo: simple rule: if requests < 100 in window, show 'insufficient data' instead of an absolute. or show a confidence band.
Tom: +1 for confidence band. Also we should surface the sample rate and the inferred correction factor. right now it's magic.
Megan: implementation detail — our offline job currently backfills prefetch credits in batches; there's a lag. sometimes the dashboard queries the live stream and not the backfilled reconciliations, causing temporary negatives.
Aisha: so two problems: (1) presentation for end users, (2) real correctness during reconciliation windows. both need fixes.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: econ-reconciler/2026-03-21T09:00Z -> prod (by @Leo) :rocket:
Leo: for (2) i can add a 'reconciliation_complete' flag to the per-tenant row so dashboard can gray out transient numbers. low-effort and avoids confusion.
Tom: for (1) UX idea — show a toggle: 'Show experimental amortized credits' with a short explainer. default off for PMs.
Megan: also we should clamp the savings per-tenant to the range [-max_overrun, +inf) where max_overrun = max(predicted_prefetch_cost, some pct). prevents tiny negative noise from flipping sign.
Aisha: i like clamp + sample threshold + reconciliation flag. rollout plan?
Leo: propose: 
- short-term (1): add reconciliation_complete boolean to the materialized view (backend).
- short-term (2): clamp tiny negatives to 0 in the UI for tenants with <100 requests and show 'insufficient data'.
- medium (3): add confidence interval + sample rate display in the header.
- medium (4): expose an API param `include_amortized_prefetch=true` for power users.
Tom: estimate: backend change ~1d, UI clamp + toggle ~1d, confidence band ~2d.
Megan: also add telemetry: track how often users toggle the experimental view and whether they click through help text.
Aisha: can we ship the clamp + flag this week? product wants it before Friday sync.
Leo: i can push the reconciliation flag and clamp today, will open PR in ~2h.
Tom: i'll add a small migration for the materialized view and a note in the runbook.
Megan: i'll draft the tooltip text. suggestion: 'Amortized cache credits are reconciled periodically; small tenants may show transient negative values. Toggle to see experimental amortized view.'
Aisha: perfect. once PRs land, can we add an automated smoke check that verifies no tenant shows < -0.01 * monthly_cost? just to catch regressions.
Leo: good idea. i'll add a check to the dashboard CI.
Tom: FYI, related: per-model unit economics card needs a similar 'sample size' dimmer. created an issue: ENG-1298.
Megan: thanks — tracking in the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
Aisha: awesome. thanks team. ping me when the PRs are up and i'll pull into product review.
deploy-bot: PR merged: econ-reconciler (by @Leo) — includes reconciliation flag + mv bump. CI: green.
Tom: deployed to staging. can folks verify the 'insufficient data' behavior on tiny tenants?
Megan: checked staging, tiny tenant row shows 'insufficient data' and the card no longer goes negative. looks good.
Aisha: marking as resolved for the Friday sync. follow-ups: confidence band and API toggle.
Leo: noted. will queue next sprint.
Megan: adding telemetry hooks now.
Aisha: thanks all! :raised_hands:
